description: Loan details page displaying loan information and a button to trigger AJAX request for total loan payment calculations. VULNERABLE TO IDOR via user_id parameter.
notes: Page contains embedded JavaScript with AJAX call to /total_loan_payments. VULNERABLE TO IDOR: /loan_details?user_id=X parameter allows viewing loan details of other users. JavaScript makes GET request to /total_loan_payments with principal, payment, and term parameters.
